note: Plan rules for the Plan meds check. The formulary files say which drugs are on a list; these rules say what each plan actually pays. Plan rules always win over copays printed in the formulary files. status: list = check meds against a list; not_on_file = plan has a list but CHA does not have it; no_list = no drug list exists for this plan.
